description: Use when someone wants postcards made or sent from a photo, to one person or many. Creates an unpaid order with one postcard per recipient, each with an optional note, and returns a link where the person reviews every card and address and pays; it never charges money or mails anything. Mailed from the US: 4×6 cards to 194 countries, 6×9 cards within the US.

challenge.description: The id of a challenge this tool answered with, and the answers to its four questions in the order asked, each a short string. The proof-of-work question takes a few million SHA-256 hashes.

note.description: The note for the back of each card, up to 350 characters, unless a recipient has its own.

order_url.description: The link of an unpaid order this tool returned earlier. The new pieces are added to it instead of starting a new order.

photo.description: A file reference to an image uploaded or generated in this conversation, with download_url and file_id filled in by the host.

photo_base64.description: The image file's own bytes as base64 or a data: URL. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to about 10 MB.

photo_url.description: A public https:// URL of an image that is already online.

recipient.description: Whatever is known of one recipient's mailing address; every field is optional. country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US.

recipients.description: Up to 50 recipients, one piece each, in place of recipient. Every field is optional.

note.description: A note for this recipient's card, used instead of the shared note.

size.description: 4x6 (the default) or 6x9. Only 4x6 can be mailed outside the US.

name: send_postcard

continue_url.description: The same link as url, for agents that carry checkout on in a browser.

address.description: deliverable, corrected (a suggested address is on the review page), warning, undeliverable, incomplete or unchecked.

expected_delivery.description: Once mailed: the date USPS expects to deliver it, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: draft or pending_payment until the person pays; paid while printing; mailed once every piece is with USPS; failed if any piece couldn't be mailed.

url.description: The link the person opens to review every piece, fix addresses and pay. It expires after about a week.

title: Create postcard order
